packageRules.description: One branch per ecosystem rather than one for the whole fleet. A failing check then parks only the ecosystem it belongs to, and a revert names what broke. Grouping by manager also subsumes the monorepo presets that the base configuration brings, because a monorepo's packages all share one ecosystem; those presets are left to decide major, which is where a coordinated bump actually matters
Workflow actions move on their own cadence and break the pipeline rather than the product, so they are worth reading apart from application dependencies
A base image carries an operating system, not a library, so its blast radius is the runtime rather than the call graph

Every Python manager is named rather than matched on a category, because extraction happens before categories are known and the fleet mixes pyproject, requirements and setup.cfg in the same repository
Toolchain pins decide what a contributor's machine runs, not what the product ships, so they are their own branch

Digest and pin moves keep the tag, so they are a rebuilt layer rather than an upgrade decision and belong in one branch of their own. The ageing requirement is cleared here deliberately: a digest carries no release timestamp to age against, and minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour: timestamp-required would otherwise hold every one of them indefinitely

A pre-1.0 package may break on a minor and semver permits it, so it leaves the automerging group into one of its own. WARNING: it must leave rather than merely lose automerge, because a branch automerges only when every upgrade in it does, so a single pre-1.0 member would park the whole group

A major upgrade is a decision, not a refresh, so it waits to be asked for on the dashboard and is never folded into an ecosystem group. The longer quarantine is the same reasoning applied to time: a major carries the breaking change by definition, so it gets the far end of the window rather than the near one

Anything that will merge itself says so on the pull request. Assignees are withheld from these on purpose: a pull request that merges itself needs no owner, and only the branches that ask for a decision are worth a notification
Minor is qualified because the pre-1.0 rule above withholds automerge from it
